name: GUAN DAN
description: Guan Dan (??), also known as Guandan or 'Throwing Eggs', is a Chinese partnership climbing and shedding card game for four players in fixed partnerships. Teams advance through rank levels from 2 through Ace; current-level hearts are wild and bombs can beat ordinary combinations.

content.text: Guan Dan (??), also known as Guandan or 'Throwing Eggs', is a Chinese partnership climbing and shedding card game for four players in fixed partnerships. Teams advance through rank levels from 2 through Ace; current-level hearts are wild and bombs can beat ordinary combinations.
Originated in Huai'an, Jiangsu Province, China. The name Guan Dan (??) is commonly rendered as 'Throwing Eggs' or 'Smashing Eggs'.
4 players in 2 fixed partnerships (partners sit opposite).
108 cards: 2 standard 52-card decks + 4 Jokers (2 Red/Colored, 2 Black/Monochrome).
108 cards: 2 standard 52-card decks + 4 Jokers (2 Red/Colored, 2 Black/Monochrome).
Deal all 108 cards equally: 27 cards per player.
